title: 第1606章 托付第1605章 燕北天与拓拔雄的心思
slug: 洪荒帝主第1616章韩家逼跪
content_zh:
李天回到房内，并未多想什么，便进入了修炼状态。
——
翌日清晨，天光大亮。
李天从偏房走出来时，杨姨正在灶台边忙着，锅里的水汽正沿着锅盖边缘升起。
老陈坐在门槛上，手里端着一碗热粥。
李天在桌边坐下，吃完杨姨端来的粥，将空碗放在桌上，然后站起身，看向两人：“陈叔，杨姨，我该走了。”
杨姨背对着他，在灶台边收拾：“路上小心。”
老陈没有起身：“走吧。”
李天没有立刻走，心念一动，手里多出一个布袋，然后走向陈叔，坐在门槛上。
他心念一动，一只灰扑扑的旧布袋出现在李天手中，巴掌大小，口沿用一根普通的麻绳系着。
他在老陈旁边的门槛上坐下，将布袋放在两人之间：“陈叔，这半年承蒙你和杨姨照顾。这里有些金币和丹药，你们留着用。”
老陈看了一眼那只布袋，没有立刻伸手，沉默了片刻才开口：“我们有用的，你自己留着。”
李天微微一笑，说道：“这些东西对我们来说，没什么用，我身上还有很多，但是全部给你们怕引来别人对你们的窥视，只能给这么点，希望你不要嫌弃。”
老陈没有再推辞，伸手拿起那只布袋，在手里掂了掂，没有打开看，直接收进怀里：“行，那我收下了。”
他顿了顿，“你一个人在外面，自己当心。”
李天点了点头：“我知道。”
他又从储物戒指中取出几枚玉瓶，放在门槛上，“陈叔，这些药用法都写在里面了。养气丹您和杨姨每月服一粒，外伤药和解毒丹的用法也写在里面了。”
老陈一一收了。
李天没有再坐下去，站起身：“我走了。”
他迈步跨出了院门。

晨光从东面铺展过来，将他前方的路照得通亮。
他沿着村路走去，没有回头。
老陈坐在门槛上，看着那道青衫背影越走越远，直到消失在村路尽头的转弯处。
他在门槛上坐了一会儿，然后低头看了看怀中的布袋，没有打开，只是伸手按了按，站起身走回屋里。
杨姨正在灶台边收拾，听到脚步声，没有回头：“走了？”
老陈应了一声：“走了。”
他在桌边坐下，将那几只玉瓶放在桌上，又取出布袋放在一旁，解开麻绳看了看里面——上百枚金币在晨光中泛着温润的光泽。
他将布袋重新系好，连同玉瓶一并收进柜中，像是什么都没有发生过一样。
——与此同时，李天在离开陈叔和杨姨视线之后，腾空而起，化作一道流光朝青柳城往北三十里的一个山谷而去。
晨光从东面铺展开来，将下方连绵的山影和稀疏的村落镀上一层浅金色。
他飞了约莫一盏茶的功夫，前方的地貌开始变化——两侧的山势收拢，形成一道狭窄的谷口，谷口处有极淡的灵力波动，像是一层薄薄的水幕覆盖在石壁上，若不细看根本察觉不到。
他在谷口处落了下来，没有直接闯进去，在距离谷口数丈处站定。
片刻后，一名值守弟子从谷口内的阴影中走出，目光落在李天身上，抱拳道：“阁下是？”
content_en:
Li Tian returned to the room and entered the cultivation state without thinking much.
——
The next morning, the sky was bright.
When Li Tian walked out of the side room, Aunt Yang was busy at the stove, and the water vapor in the pot was rising along the edge of the pot lid.
Lao Chen was sitting on the threshold, holding a bowl of hot porridge in his hand.
Li Tian sat down at the table, finished the porridge brought by Aunt Yang, put the empty bowl on the table, then stood up and looked at the two of them: "Uncle Chen, Aunt Yang, it's time for me to go."
Aunt Yang turned her back to him and tidied up beside the stove: "Be careful on the road."
Lao Chen didn't get up: "Let's go."
Li Tian did not leave immediately. With a thought, he took out a cloth bag in his hand, then walked towards Uncle Chen and sat on the threshold.
As soon as he thought about it, a dusty old cloth bag appeared in Li Tian's hand, the size of a palm, and the mouth was tied with an ordinary hemp rope.
He sat down on the threshold next to Old Chen and placed the cloth bag between the two of them: "Uncle Chen, I have been taken care of by you and Aunt Yang these six months. There are some gold coins and elixirs here for you to keep for your use."
Lao Chen glanced at the cloth bag, but did not reach out immediately. He was silent for a moment before speaking: "You can keep it for yourself if it is useful to us."
Li Tian smiled slightly and said: "These things are of no use to us. I still have a lot of them, but I am giving them all to you for fear of attracting others to peep at you. I can only give you so much. I hope you don't dislike it."
Lao Chen didn't refuse anymore. He reached out and picked up the cloth bag, weighed it in his hand, and put it into his arms without opening it. "Okay, I'll take it."
He paused and said, "You are out there alone, so be careful."
Li Tian nodded: "I know."
He took out a few more jade bottles from the storage ring and placed them on the threshold, "Uncle Chen, the usage of these medicines are all written in them. You and Aunt Yang should take one Qi-nourishing pill every month, and the usage of trauma medicine and detoxification pills are also written in it."
Lao Chen accepted them one by one.
Li Tian did not sit down again, but stood up: "I'm leaving."
He stepped out of the courtyard gate.
The morning light spread from the east, illuminating the road ahead of him.
He walked along the village road without looking back.
Old Chen sat on the threshold and watched the green-shirted figure walking further and further away until it disappeared at the turn at the end of the village road.
He sat on the threshold for a while, then looked down at the cloth bag in his arms. He didn't open it, but stretched out his hand to press it, stood up and walked back into the house.
Aunt Yang was cleaning up at the stove when she heard footsteps and didn't look back: "Leaving?"
Lao Chen responded: "Let's go."
He sat down at the table, put the jade bottles on the table, took out the cloth bag and put it aside, untied the hemp rope and looked inside - hundreds of gold coins glowed with a warm luster in the morning light.
He tied the bag again and put it into the cabinet together with the jade bottle, as if nothing had happened.
——At the same time, after Li Tian left the sight of Uncle Chen and Aunt Yang, he rose into the sky and turned into a stream of light heading towards a valley thirty miles north of Qingliu City.
The morning light spreads from the east, coating the continuous mountain shadows and sparse villages below with a layer of light gold.
It took him about a cup of tea to fly, and the landscape in front began to change - the mountains on both sides converged, forming a narrow valley mouth. There was a very faint spiritual energy fluctuation at the valley mouth, like a thin layer of water curtain covering the stone wall, which could not be noticed unless you looked closely.
He landed at the entrance of the valley, did not rush in directly, and stood a few feet away from the entrance of the valley.
After a while, a disciple on duty walked out of the shadows inside the valley entrance, his eyes fell on Li Tian, ​​cupped his fists and said, "Who is your Excellency?"
